name: release-readiness

release.distribution: local static directory plus deterministic tar.gz

nonGoals: new PICO-8 API or compatibility behavior
Firefox, WebKit, mobile or non-Chrome release support
remote creation, Git tag, GitHub Release or website deployment
BBS crawling, arbitrary URL loading or third-party cart redistribution
full external corpus requalification, historical matrix or long soak
granting an open-source license for project-owned code

10A.name: Release Freeze
exit: version, distribution, license status and publication boundary are machine-locked
10B becomes the only active work unit

10B.name: Public Metadata and Notices
exit: public compatibility counts and links match the current inventory
all workspace package versions and license status match the release contract
project and third-party license boundaries are explicit

10C.name: Artifact Finalization
exit: manifest carries product version, API version and complete provenance inputs
release directory contains project license and complete combined notices
deterministic tar.gz and SHA256SUMS verify byte-exact across repeated builds

10D.name: Bounded Release Validation
exit: quick verification and focused Chrome release lifecycle pass
bounded project-owned format and lifecycle fixtures pass
external corpus, historical matrix and long soak runs remain zero

10E.name: Local RC Assembly
exit: local archive can be unpacked and verified without repository-relative inputs
release notes, manifest and checksums identify one 0.1.0-rc.1 candidate
open P0 and P1 release blockers are zero

10F.name: Evidence and Local Handoff
exit: aggregate-only immutable exit evidence is committed
the clean verified implementation is committed locally without remote or tag
